title: Rename the default theme to instantsearch
body:
The default theme is actually the minimum set of rules we need to define to have a usable UI. 
- [x] Move `themes/default.css` to `instantsearch.css`
- [x] Update the documentation to explain our users that they need to include it
- [x] Patch the pre-processor to generate empty rules to be eventually used as a skeleton
